selection.inner_split_policy: fold-local task-aware CV; grouped when subject_id supplied
selection.selection_rule: highest development per-family outer-CV mean; lexicographic tie-break

validation.family_scope: fixed family per outer CV; family selected from development summaries
validation.preprocessing_scope: fit within inner and outer training folds; FSS/BSS internal scoring uses upstream training-fold preprocessing

warnings: The development outer-CV scores describe fixed estimator families; the winning family was selected using those scores. Only the selected family has a heldout result.
